name: Max Keller
education: B.S. in Information Technology, University of Colorado Boulder
summary: Senior DevOps engineer with 8 years of infrastructure experience running Docker and Kubernetes on Linux and automating with Terraform, having built delivery pipelines on Jenkins and GitLab rather than GitHub Actions.
strengths: Long-running Linux administration and systems engineering background
Operates Kubernetes clusters and Dockerized workloads in production

Self-hosted pipeline experience with Jenkins and GitLab CI
gaps: No GitHub Actions experience - all CI/CD work runs on Jenkins and GitLab CI

resumeText: Max Keller is a Senior DevOps Engineer at Northwood Supply Chain with eight years of infrastructure experience. He operates Docker and Kubernetes workloads on Linux, automates infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible, and has built self-hosted CI/CD pipelines on Jenkins and GitLab CI. He is a generalist who values reliable self-hosted tooling, and is now looking to adopt GitHub Actions workflows.
